title: 第5章 三小姐许雯秋第6章 晋级炼气中期
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
这个大开杀戒的年轻人，正是李凡。
本来，李凡不想多管闲事，何奈这个什么仙师得寸进尺。
原本，李凡只是躲在装满高档绸缎的货车里，打算搭个顺风车，免得自己一个人赶路，显得多少有点引人注意。
可是，事与愿违，竟然遇到这么一伙不知死活的家伙。
不仅抢钱，还要抢人，李凡看这架势，早晚这些货物也难逃魔掌。
权衡利弊，既然自己早晚被发现，李凡何不自己先出来现身，也可以来一次英雄救美的戏份。
至于大开杀戒，一个不留，李凡当然是有自己的考虑。
不怕一万就怕万一。
自己的行踪，最好不要暴露。
这些强盗，嘴可不怎么严实，无毒不丈夫，统统灭杀，只有死人，才不会走漏消息。
杀人灭口，毁尸灭迹。
这一伙强盗被李凡直接秒杀。
要知道，这伙强盗都会一些世俗的武功，有几个算得上是高手。
不过，在李凡面前，如同三岁孩童，毫无招架之力。
仙凡有别！
在仙法面前，凡人如同蝼蚁一般，只有被秒杀的份儿。
“这？”
看到李凡的目光看过来，管家不由自主的护住身后的轿子。
“管家，不必如此！”
轿子的门帘打开，走出一位姿态高贵，花容月貌的女子。

女子大概二十岁上下，却显得十分沉稳，对着李凡微微屈膝行礼，“小女子许雯秋，给仙师行礼，感谢仙师出手相救，灭杀贼寇！”
“好说！”
伸手不打笑脸人，李凡回礼。
“仙师，我们西凤商盟正好缺一个供奉，不知道仙师可有兴趣？”
许雯秋小心翼翼的问。
“哦？”
李凡一怔。
“仙师，这个供奉职位，一般不需要您做什么，只是一个震慑作用。
如果，有意外事件，需要您出手，您可自行考虑，如果选择出手，本商盟还会奉上额外的酬谢！”
许雯秋说道。
沉思片刻，李凡又问，“需要我镇守哪里？”
“源城！这是一个仙凡混居的城市，人员复杂，城市规模并不大，也基本上没有高级修士，更没有什么大势力，或者修仙门派。
我们可以给仙师担保，帮仙师办理源城的长期居住权。”
许雯秋试图劝说。
长期居住权？
这可是李凡最需要的东西。
源城，距离出事的天贵城已经有千里之远，适合李凡长期居住。
content_en:
This young man who went on a killing spree was none other than Li Fan.
Originally, Li Fan didn't want to meddle in other people's business, but this immortal master took advantage of him.
Originally, Li Fan was just hiding in a truck filled with high-end silk and satin, intending to hitch a ride so that he wouldn't have to travel alone and look somewhat attracting attention.
However, contrary to expectations, I encountered such a group of guys who did not know how to live or die.
Not only are they robbing money, they are also robbing people. Looking at Li Fan's attitude, sooner or later these goods will not escape the clutches.
Weighing the pros and cons, since he would be discovered sooner or later, why not Li Fan show up first, so that he could play a role of a hero saving the beauty.
As for going on a killing spree and leaving no one alive, Li Fan certainly had his own considerations.
Don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of the eventuality.
It is best not to expose your whereabouts.
These robbers are not very strict with their mouths. They are not poisonous or husbands. They will all be killed. Only the dead will prevent the news from leaking.
Kill people and silence them, destroy their bodies and destroy their traces.
This group of robbers was instantly killed by Li Fan.
You know, this group of robbers know some secular martial arts, and some of them are considered masters.
However, in front of Li Fan, he was like a three-year-old child, powerless to resist.
There is a difference between immortals and mortals!
In front of the immortal magic, mortals are like ants and can only be killed instantly.
"This?"
Seeing Li Fan looking over, the housekeeper couldn't help but protect the sedan behind him.
"Butler, it doesn't have to be like this!"
The curtain of the sedan chair opened, and a woman with noble posture and beautiful face stepped out.
The woman was about twenty years old, but she looked very calm. She bowed slightly to Li Fan and saluted, "Xu Wenqiu, my little girl, salutes the immortal master and thanks the immortal master for his rescue and killing the bandits!"
"Easy to say!"
Li Fan extended his hand to avoid hitting the smiling person, and Li Fan returned the favor.
"Master Immortal, our Xifeng Merchant Alliance happens to be short of a worshipper. I wonder if Master Immortal is interested?"
Xu Wenqiu asked cautiously.
"Oh?"
Li Fan was startled.
"Master Immortal, this enshrined position generally does not require you to do anything, it is just a deterrent.
If there is an unexpected incident that requires you to take action, you can consider it yourself. If you choose to take action, our business alliance will also provide additional rewards! "
Xu Wenqiu said.
After thinking for a moment, Li Fan asked again, "Where do you need me to guard?"
"Origin City! This is a city where immortals and mortals live together. The people are complex, the city is not large, and there are basically no high-level monks, and there are no big forces or immortal sects.
We can guarantee the immortal master and help him apply for long-term residence in Source City. "
Xu Wenqiu tried to persuade.
Long-term residency?
This is what Li Fan needs most.
Yuancheng is thousands of miles away from Tiangui City where the accident occurred, and is suitable for Li Fan to live for a long time.
